destination.name: Suqian
destination.tagline: Hometown of the warlord Xiang Yu, set between Luoma Lake and the Grand Canal.
destination.description: Suqian is the hometown of Xiang Yu, King of Western Chu, and lies between two large freshwater lakes, Luoma and Hongze. The Grand Canal and the old course of the Yellow River pass through the area. Its sights are the Xiang Yu ancestral home, a city museum and a forest park on the shore of Luoma Lake. The city is also known in China for its liquor, with the Yanghe and Shuanggou brands made here.
whyVisit: Trace the story of Xiang Yu
Walk the wooded shore of Luoma Lake

goodToKnow.title: Well connected by rail
goodToKnow.detail: Suqian's railway station sits on the high-speed network, and city buses cover the town widely at low fares.

goodToKnow.title: Ticket prices vary
goodToKnow.detail: Santaishan Forest Park is listed at ¥20 to ¥60, so check the price at the gate. Xiang Yu's ancestral home costs about ¥80.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Qianlong called Suqian the best place in spring, and {months} bring mild weather for lakeside walks.
